# Analysis command tests

# Test transitions command
sc transitions chart.json
stdout 'green -> yellow \[TIMER\]'
stdout 'yellow -> red \[TIMER\]'
stdout 'red -> green \[TIMER\]'

# Test transitions with --from filter
sc transitions --from green chart.json
stdout 'green -> yellow'
! stdout 'red -> green'

# Test transitions with --to filter
sc transitions --to red chart.json
stdout 'yellow -> red'
! stdout 'red -> green'

# Test orphans command
sc orphans chart.json
stdout 'root'

# Test sinks command
sc sinks chart.json
stdout 'root'

# Test disconnected command
sc disconnected chart.json
stdout 'root'

# Test reachable command
sc reachable chart.json
stdout 'green'
stdout 'yellow'
stdout 'red'
! stdout 'root'

# Test unreachable command
sc unreachable chart.json
stdout 'root'

# Test path command
sc path green red chart.json
stdout 'green'
stdout 'yellow'
stdout 'red'

# Test analyze command
sc analyze chart.json
stdout 'Analysis: traffic_light'
stdout 'States:'
stdout 'Transitions:'
stdout 'Orphans'
stdout 'Sinks'

# Test JSON output for orphans
sc orphans --json chart.json
stdout '"orphans"'
stdout '"root"'

-- chart.json --
{
  "name": "traffic_light",
  "rootState": {
    "label": "root",
    "type": 2,
    "children": [
      {"label": "green", "type": 1, "isInitial": true},
      {"label": "yellow", "type": 1},
      {"label": "red", "type": 1}
    ]
  },
  "transitions": [
    {"from": ["green"], "to": ["yellow"], "event": "TIMER"},
    {"from": ["yellow"], "to": ["red"], "event": "TIMER"},
    {"from": ["red"], "to": ["green"], "event": "TIMER"}
  ]
}
